name: Hybrid Rendering for Stress Tensor Fields
definition: A visualization approach combining volume rendering with glyphs and tensorlines to separate focus and context regions in stress tensor datasets. Context is visualized by volume rendering of scalar invariants, while focus regions (selected via user interaction) display explicit geometrical tensor representations.
summary: Hybrid Rendering for Stress Tensor Fields combines volume rendering with geometric glyphs to decouple global context from local detail, reducing visual clutter in dense tensor fields.
